basis: User-accepted four scientific decision rules, frozen corrected UAT semantics at 25d0cff and exact authoritative spans; authored before planner comparison, not inferred from KG-enabled outputs.
scope: Four existing synthetic Ledger scenarios only; candidate knowledge, no promotion or broad scientific qualification.
comparison_policy: Compare every raw plan/result field and resolved reused Ledger record, preserving list order. Exclude only result.scientific_applicability_results. These fixtures have deterministic IDs and no timestamps, so no other exclusions are authorized.
metric_policy: Per-scenario binary opportunity denominators for unnecessary steps, invalid reuse, inappropriate scheduling and correct allow/block. Preserve offending step/record counts separately. Explanation checks are independent binary opportunities; nonapplicable requirements use not_applicable. No composite score.
classification_policy: Any loss of a previously correct behavioral obligation or explanation obligation is regression; otherwise any corrected behavioral obligation is behavioral improvement; otherwise any improved explanation obligation is same behavior, explanation/provenance improvement; otherwise no observed incremental contribution.

scenarios.decision_rule: Current, aligned, governed neighbor graph can feed Leiden directly. Neither PCA/neighbors recomputation nor UMAP is required.
scenarios.source_basis: Frozen Leiden graph requirement and representation reuse constraints; exact evidence bindings in scientific_kg_v1_uat_decision_rules.
